messages:
Maria_CSM: Quick heads-up — Clearwave onboarding call flagged repeated P95 latency misses vs their agreed SLO (p95 embeddings target 200ms). Need to capture for renewal readiness and decide on any pro-rated credit.
Alex_SE: Saw the same in dashboards. Spikes around 2024-04-03 13:20 UTC, p95 ~320-450ms for embedding batches. Likely cold KV cache + large batch sizes.
Daniel_SRE: Created INC-2401 and attached traces: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2401. Short summary below.
Daniel_SRE: ```
window: 2024-04-03T13:00:00Z - 2024-04-03T14:00:00Z
p95 latency (embeddings): 380ms
uptime (svc): 99.88%
requests: 8.2k
errors: 0.2%
```
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2401 created by Daniel_SRE. Severity: P2. Pager on-call notified.
Priya_CS: Customer asked for a written explanation + whether they qualify for a service credit. Renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks — this is a potential risk.
Sam_AE: Contract says uptime SLO = 99.95% monthly. Need standard credit calc. Can someone run the SLA math and propose the credit amount?
Lila_Onboard: Onboarding notes: Clearwave is using batch_size=128 with prefix caching disabled. I'll run a quick smoke with cache enabled and batch_size=64.
Alex_SE: Temp mitigation: enable prefix/KV caching for their workspace, reduce batch size to 64, and route them to the dedicated low-latency pool for the remainder of onboarding window. Will add a short playbook.
Ravi_Product: If routing to dedicated, we should log the config change and time window so CS can include it in the report. Also consider a short-term priority token so jobs don't contend.
Daniel_SRE: Proposed remediation timeline:
- Today: enable KV cache + reduce batch size (Lila/Alex)
- Today EOD: validate with synthetic load and confirm p95 <250ms
- 72h: monitor for regressions, keep dedicated routing if stable
- Post-mortem: include root cause and long-term fix (kernel scheduling / batching heuristics)
Priya_CS: For the customer-facing report I need: exact downtime/uplift minutes, p95 delta, credit calc, and next steps.
Daniel_SRE: Preliminary numbers: monthly uptime observed 99.88% vs 99.95% SLA -> delta 0.07%. Using contract matrix (see internal formula) that maps 0.05-0.1% under to 2-3% credit.
Sam_AE: Can we standardize on a proposed credit of 2.5% for the month and offer a one-time onboarding discount of 1% as gesture? That should remove immediate renewal friction.
Maria_CSM: That seems reasonable. I'll draft the external note: root cause, steps taken, credit calc, timeline, and ask for sign-off.
Alex_SE: Draft snippet for report: "On 2024-04-03 we observed elevated p95 latency due to KV cache misses and large batch sizes. We applied cache, reduced batch size, and elevated routing which restored p95 to <240ms within 3 hours. We propose a 2.5% service credit for April and a 1% onboarding goodwill credit."
Priya_CS: +1 — include attachments: INC-2401 timeline, graphs (p95 timeseries), and the synthetic test commands we ran.
Lila_Onboard: I'll attach the exact config diff here after tests: ```diff
- batch_size: 128
+ batch_size: 64
- kv_cache: off
+ kv_cache: on
```
Ravi_Product: Also include a short note about long-term improvements we're tracking: batching heuristic tuning and better cold-cache priming for embeddings.
Sam_AE: I'll be on the call with the customer Friday. Please have the one-page and credit calc ready by EOD Thursday so we can review.
Maria_CSM: Action items assigned: Daniel -> final numbers and postmortem, Alex/Lila -> mitigation proof and config diff, Priya -> draft customer note, Ravi -> product follow-up items, Sam -> customer call. I'll circulate draft for sign-off.
Alex_SE: FYI I'll add a small synthetic test command for Priya: `ab --dur 60 --concurrency 10 https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings` — will post outputs.
Priya_CS: Thanks. If we go with 2.5% + 1% goodwill, please add that to the invoice notes.
Maria_CSM: Noted. I'll upload the pack to the renewal folder and tag @Sam_AE when ready. :thumbsup:
Sam_AE: :thumbsup:
Priya_CS: Thanks team — will capture customer feedback on the call and add to the CRM.
Maria_CSM: Closing the thread once final numbers and note uploaded.
